title: Going Beneath the Surface: Evaluating Image Captioning for Grammaticality, Truthfulness and Diversity
answer_short: Diversity is measured at the word or sentence level, focusing on language variability, word recall, and compositional novelty, with diversity scores computed as the ratio of observed to optimal number of language constructions.
answer_rationale: Diversity in captions is measured through metrics that focus on language variability, word-level recall, and compositional novelty.
